title: Laptop
prompt: a laptop: open the lid, press power, it boots, plug in the charger, the fan spins up under load; see-through shows the motherboard, CPU with heat pipe and fan, battery, SSD, speakers, hinge and display cable
blurb: Open the lid and press power to boot it, plug in the charger to fill the battery, then load the CPU and watch the heat pipe carry heat to a blower fan that spins up and pushes hot air out the back.
